question: In a certain code language, “XPCF” is written as “WOBE” and “LRVA” is written as “KQUZ”. How will “BMWG” be written in that language?
solution:
Here, we use the table given below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b1bafe27611de996d502213b3b9e476c547aa8e452df1a5f3b5fc0c4ba01f7a2.png] ​

The logic followed in the given code language:

“XPCF” is written as “WOBE” →

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1d742c25c570a5598370496e3c76c0c733866d8242530efe3c7e07cbd6b35cd1.png] 

“LRVA” is written as “KQUZ” →

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/db803d6e9e2ee8d31dfd1ad5529573edb39e25a0280318354766da149c817940.png] 

Similarly, 'BMWG' will be written as:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c1a0a6839f14a9077905377bfe23c5280ee4bc4944885fd36245d8667582830a.png] 

Here, 'BMWG' is written as **'ALVF'.**

Hence, the correct answer is "Option (3)".
